sermon.title: Reaching The Gentiles Was Always The Plan
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows that reaching the Gentile nations was always God’s plan, from His promise to Abraham through David and the prophets. Israel did not take the good news to the nations, and the kingdom was given to a fruitful people. Every church is chosen to bear fruit among every nation, not to be entangled with this world.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.section_question: Were the Gentiles always God’s plan?
chunks.short_answer: Yes. In Abraham’s seed all the nations of the earth would be blessed.
chunks.text:
As we look into the Bible this morning. We’re going to be dealing with the subject that the heathen the Gentile nations was God’s first choice his first plan and God chose the Jews the people of Israel to reach those nations in Genesis chapter 10 verses 1 through 5 the Bible tells us that from Noah’s family all the Gentiles were separated on to their lands by their language. By their families and by their nations as. We read on in Genesis 26 for.

Abraham I will give your seed all of these countries and in your seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed. Now we know that that seed is talking about Jesus because that’s what the Bible tells us but we also got to understand that Abraham’s seed was Israel. And they were to reach the nations with the gospel the good news of Jesus Christ. Who was the seed that would bless the earth by turning them from their wicked ways then we read in 1st Chronicles 16 23 and 24.
